title: From Evidence to Evident: Decisive Cosmological Evidence for the Normal Neutrino Mass Hierarchy (Jimenez, Peña Garay, Simpson, Verde)
efc_relevance: Combines DESI DR2 clustering with NuFIT oscillation data to turn the neutrino mass-ordering preference into a decisive (likelihood-dominated, prior-robust) exclusion of the inverted hierarchy within standard cosmology. Tightens the Σm_ν floor inside EFC's L2→L3 inference: any EFC posterior on Σm_ν must remain compatible with the NH-decisive bound, removing the IDE-style escape valve flagged by arXiv:2606.05005.
ledger_action: Add to Validation Ledger as Σm_ν / hierarchy constraint; update gap Σm_ν-degeneracy row (added by arXiv:2606.05005) with the NH-decisive bound; cross-reference framework:LCDM-Planck2018 and arXiv:2605.21456 (negative-ν-mass vs negative-DE); required note in Predictions Ledger that EFC's L2/L3 posterior must reproduce the NH-decisive Bayes factor.
